rites.name: Morardolden
rites.text: Morardolden is the concept of the lattice of roots that the Singing draws from the dark, a pattern the orders of the Holy Age learned to read and chant along. It is less a thing than a tuning that binds the first condensing stone to the sky above.

rites.name: Osusarala
rites.text: Osusarala is the Pact-bound concept of Miilora's Fall, the moment the Sundering broke the old worlds into Shards and the oath of the Pact was sworn over the wreckage. It persists as a binding principle that holds fragments of Miilora to their shared promises.
